skill.procedure:
def apply(inputs, premises):
    lengths = inputs["bag_lengths"]
    widths = inputs["bag_widths"]
    heights = inputs["bag_heights"]
    surcharges = inputs["surcharges"]
    personal_used = False
    carry_on_used = False
    checked_count = 0
    total = int(inputs["ticket_price"])
    for i in range(len(lengths)):
        length = int(lengths[i])
        width = int(widths[i])
        height = int(heights[i])
        fits_personal = length <= int(premises["personal_item_limits"][0]) and width <= int(premises["personal_item_limits"][1]) and height <= int(premises["personal_item_limits"][2])
        fits_carry_on = length <= int(premises["carry_on_limits"][0]) and width <= int(premises["carry_on_limits"][1]) and height <= int(premises["carry_on_limits"][2])
        cabin_item = False
        if fits_personal and not personal_used:
            personal_used = True
            cabin_item = True
        elif fits_carry_on and not carry_on_used:
            carry_on_used = True
            cabin_item = True
        if not cabin_item:
            checked_count = checked_count + 1
            fee_index = min(checked_count - 1, len(premises["checked_base_fees"]) - 1)
            total = total + int(premises["checked_base_fees"][fee_index]) + int(surcharges[i])
    return {"answer": int(total)}
